MyLink developed by China Mobile Hong Kong is an all-rounded, Comprehensive-Smart APP offering a variety of experiences and benefits to HongKong residents. MyLink is committed to serve every aspect of daily lives in efforts to provide flexible communication service. MyLink provides users with rich life information, intelligent life applications and is also a "smart assistants" for Hong Kong residents.

● AI Smart Assistant: Added text input function. Users can not only communicate with "A Link" through voice, but also enter text in the dialog box. Come and experience it.

● MyGarden Carbon Reduction Task: A new carbon reduction task is added. Users can earn up to 150g of CR Exp by completing all limited tasks. Come and join in!

● My Friends: Added “search phone numbers to add friends”, allowing users to directly to find and send friend requests by searching other MyLink users phone number.

● Metaverse event venue: You can immerse yourself in the fun of shopping and experience a wealth of comprehensive activities in the activity venue.

● E-coupon：Added the function of converting some electronic coupons into additional items. You can easily see the transfer button on the details page, and you can transfer it to friends.

● A new experience in new e-commerce: new cash coupons, flash sale products for a limited time, logistics upgrades, free shipping and delivery, and a lot of points will be sent immediately after placing an order. Customers can choose the nearest location to pick up the goods through self-pickup, without waiting.

● MyLink Metaverse upgraded:  MyHome has improved home layout flexibility and can arrange more styles of furniture; the personal image dressing function has been upgraded to create your new virtual image; MyCity brings an immersive city experience and enters the digital twin Hong Kong with one click.

● Personalized My Zone: New personal exclusive My Meta ID , personalized image and costume for creating a unique "My Zone".

● New interactive experience in sending flowers: Establish a friendship relationship with each other in MyLink. After the plants are planted, you can give plant decorations to your friends, and your friends can decorate the decorations in MyHome.

● "Jetso" Ulimate upgrade: 
Added search function for direct access to products, shopping districts, and other services; 
Added location switching function to view accurate product and service information by region;  Optimized information flow recommendation in the Points Mall for a more user-friendly experience! Earn the greatest with member privilege; Enjoy the best for purchasing thousands of famous-brand products with fast delivery!

● "Lucky Blind Box Daily Rewards": you can win up to 10,000 MyLink Points every day, and have chances to get a series of e-coupons


● Visiting Hong Kong services: Visa, cross-border transportation guides and discounts, and discounts on food, drink, and entertainment in Hong Kong are all available through MyLink to fully enjoy your trip!

● Cross-border bus: A new cross-border bus ticket purchase service is launched, and a large number of value-for-money coupons are launched from time to time.
